Name: Experience Multipliers
Author: Falson127
Description:
I threw this mod together quickly shortly after starting a new 1.6 playthrough and lamenting how much slower foraging feels compared to all the other skills. After searching, I only saw one other mod that appeared to do this, and it hasn't been updated in over 4 years so I figured I'd put this out for anyone else that wants it.

This mod uses harmony to patch game files, so it may break with other mods that do the same. I'll say though, I'm testing it with SVE and some other fairly common/popular mods and it doesn't seem to cause any conflicts with them. Your mileage may vary.

Compatible with Generic Mod Config Menu, so you can change the multipliers in-game, and the changes will take effect right away without requiring a restart

Downloads.Description: Has fix for a floating point issue that could set xp gain to 0 unintentionally. If you want to disable xp gain in a skill for some reason, set the multiplier to a negative value and all xp gain will be set to 0 in that skill

Manifest.Name: Experience Multiplier
Manifest.Description: Allows you to set a multiplier for experience gain in each of the 5 skills. Each skill can have a different multiplier value
